reviews.author: Sanya Malhotra
reviews.comment: Bonbon the Bunny is even sweeter in real life! The yarn is insanely soft and the stitching is perfection. Packaged with so much love.

reviews.comment: The Rosie Granny Cardigan is my favorite clothing item now. I get compliments everywhere I go. True handmade luxury!
